Rajasthan Authorities Restrict Entry Amidst CJP School Inspection Plans

Rajasthan authorities have placed restrictions on the entry of outsiders into schools across the state. This action follows plans by the non-governmental organization Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) to inspect schools and advocate for repairs. CJP intends to visit schools in Rajasthan as part of its initiative. The state government's move aims to control access to these educational institutions during the period CJP plans its inspections.
